parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

- Starts from 1.

- Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Valid values: 1 to 50.

- Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the stack group. Call [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) to query available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group. If not specified, stack groups in all resource groups are returned.

> You can find the resource group ID on the **Resource Groups** page in the **Resource Management** console. [View the basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the stack group. If not specified, stack groups in all states are returned.

Valid values:

- ACTIVE: The stack group is active.

- DELETED: The stack group is deleted.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags of the stack group.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the stack group.

> Tags is optional. If you specify Tags, Tags.N.Key is required.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the stack group.
